'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2026-04-20 — '''Present'''|Team Falcons}} }} Finn "'''karrigan'''" Andersen {{born}} is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]]-[[:Category:Germany|German]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' player who plays as the [[:Category:In-game leaders|in-game leader]] for [[Team Falcons]]. He is regarded as one of the most successful in-game leaders in ''Counter-Strike'' history, leading the [[Team SoloMid]]-[[Astralis]] core to multiple trophies before going on to make history by winning several trophies with the international [[FaZe Clan]] and [[mousesports]] lineups. After returning to [[FaZe Clan]] in 2021, he made history once again by being the first IGL to guide an international lineup to a [[Majors|Major]] victory, doing so at [[PGL Major Antwerp 2022]]. karrigan would leave FaZe in 2026 after 5 years with the team and sign to [[Team Falcons]], with whom he would win the [[IEM Cologne Major 2026]] just 61 days after joining. karrigan is among the most decorated players in the scene, having won over 20 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments throughout his career including two [[Majors]] and an [[Intel/Grand Slam/4|Intel Grand Slam]]. ==Gear and
